limits: Six reconstructed immutable candidate or baseline recorded states, physical pose verified by retained actual palm/sole points; no renderer, asset repair or appearance score.
ROIs use exact native source-height ranges plus pelvis/thigh support; hoodie, NEW head/neck and glove surfaces excluded.
Against-skinned-normal means local fold/normal disagreement, not necessarily watertight inside-out volume or proven self-intersection.
Historical raw decoded weights, not old rendered pose, are compared to current conditioned weights; source positions and bone names verified exact.
Seat top subset comes from actual exported bodywork geometry and authored seat dimensions; projected vertex samples cannot certify whole-body collision.
